name: visitor-counter-api
description: Atomic visitor counter Lambda function backed by DynamoDB

scripts.package: npm run build && node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const { execSync } = require('child_process'); if (fs.existsSync('dist/visitor-counter.zip')) fs.unlinkSync('dist/visitor-counter.zip'); execSync('cd dist && zip -r visitor-counter.zip index.js index.js.map', { stdio: 'inherit' }); console.log('Created dist/visitor-counter.zip');"
